summary: postinstall downloads and executes unverified binary from bare-IP endpoint with TLS verification disabled
details: The package's postinstall hook downloads a.tgz archive from a hardcoded bare IPv4 endpoint (https://218.90.133.98:4443/onecode_tgz) with TLS certificate verification explicitly disabled (rejectUnauthorized:false), extracts it via `tar -xzf`, chmods the extracted binary to 0o755, and hardlinks it into bin/.onecode so it becomes the CLI invoked as `onecode`. No hash, signature, or publisher-identity verification is performed. The destination is a bare IP address rather than a domain matching the @onescience publisher, and the download URL is mutable. Installing this package causes an opaque binary from an unverified network source to be fetched and made executable on the installer's machine at install time.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
